title: Selective Glucocorticoid Receptor Modulators of Immune Checkpoint Function.
authors: Kobylski, Robin R; Min, Charles K; Nwachukwu, Jerome C; Koenig, Marcel; Zhang, Haotian; Moncada, Lizbeth; Venables, Thomas T; Schell, Bin-Bin; Stein, William J; McCown, Claudia; Schumate, Justin; Bonilla, Emelie; Sobh, Amin; Romero-Toledo, Arantxa; Pipkin, Matthew E; Janiszewska, Michalina; Scampavia, Louis; Spicer, Timothy P; Licht, Jonathan D; Rogatsky, Inez; Kamenecka, Theodore M; Solt, Laura A; Nettles, Kendall W
journal: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子动力学模拟和机器学习研究糖皮质激素受体（GR）配体变构调控免疫检查点功能，虽涉及转录因子GR的变构机制，但核心是配体-受体互作而非TF-DNA结合，方法可迁移至TF-DNA互作建模。
abstract: Glucocorticoids (GCs) coordinate immunity, inflammation, and metabolism through allosteric regulation of the glucocorticoid receptor (GR) transcription factor. GCs are indispensable anti-inflammatory drugs yet linking specific ligand-receptor structural states to specific biological outcomes has remained a major barrier to designing safer, more selective therapies. Using structure-based design, we developed selective glucocorticoid receptor modulators (SGRMs) of immune function by extending a steroidal scaffold from the ligand-binding pocket into an adjacent solvent channel. These SGRMs suppressed T cell pro-inflammatory cytokines and promoted differentiation of memory precursor T cells while showing minimal induction of M2 macrophage polarization or T cell checkpoint proteins PD-1 and CTLA-4, all key targets of immunotherapy. Molecular dynamics simulations revealed that solvent-channel substituents function as a lever arm to drive dynamic oscillations in the steroid core, thereby allosterically tuning GR activity states. Systematic perturbation of immune cells with a graded series of ligands enabled a ligand perturbation with machine learning (LPML) framework to map coregulated responses across cell types and identified effector T cell gene networks tightly coupled with immune checkpoint induction. This approach outlines a general strategy for decoding the logic of allosteric drug action, enabling the rational design of SGRMs with tailored immunomodulatory profiles.
abstract_zh: 糖皮质激素（GCs）通过糖皮质激素受体（GR）转录因子的变构调节协调免疫、炎症和代谢。GCs是不可或缺的抗炎药物，但将特定配体-受体结构状态与特定生物学结果联系起来，一直是设计更安全、更具选择性疗法的主要障碍。利用基于结构的设计，我们通过将甾体骨架从配体结合口袋延伸至相邻溶剂通道，开发了选择性糖皮质激素受体调节剂（SGRMs），用于调节免疫功能。这些SGRMs抑制T细胞促炎细胞因子并促进记忆前体T细胞分化，同时对M2巨噬细胞极化或T细胞检查点蛋白PD-1和CTLA-4的诱导作用极小，而这些都是免疫治疗的关键靶点。分子动力学模拟揭示，溶剂通道取代基作为杠杆臂驱动甾体核心的动态振荡，从而变构调节GR活性状态。通过一系列梯度配体对免疫细胞进行系统扰动，结合机器学习（LPML）框架的配体扰动，绘制了跨细胞类型的共调控反应，并识别出与免疫检查点诱导紧密耦合的效应T细胞基因网络。该方法概述了解码变构药物作用逻辑的通用策略，为合理设计具有定制免疫调节谱的SGRMs提供了可能。
